| Board | In plain terms | What it does for you |
|---|---|---|
| Sense360 Core | Hub | Runs the firmware, talks to Home Assistant over your network, and connects every module. |
| Sense360 RoomIQ | Room sensing | Detects whether the room is occupied (warm-body and optional radar sensing) and measures light level, temperature, humidity and air pressure. |
| Sense360 AirIQ | Air quality | Tracks carbon dioxide, airborne chemical (VOC and NOx) trends and gas readings so Home Assistant can drive ventilation. |
| Sense360 VentIQ | Bathroom air quality | Tracks airborne chemical (VOC and NOx) trends sized for bathrooms, alongside the room sensing that drives fan decisions. |
| Sense360 LED | Light ring | Shows room status at a glance with a ring of lights. |
| Sense360 240v PSU | Mains power | Powers the hub from a mains supply. |
| Sense360 PoE PSU | Network power | Powers the hub over the same cable as your network (PoE). |
